Three-address code / quadruples / triple: Decide from the braces whether result = sum + i*2 runs per inner iteration, per outer iteration or once; quadruples/triples only for the conditional sum part
Basic blocks / flow graph: Decide whether a = a + 2 and b = b - 1 share a block with the result > 100 test using leader rules; no CFG or optimisation asked
LL(1) parsing table: Left recursion must be removed before FIRST/FOLLOW; key removes it for B
Direct RE to DFA: Augment the expression with the end marker # and number positions before firstpos/lastpos/followpos
LR(0) / SLR parsing: SLR reduce entries go under FOLLOW of the head only (key: FOLLOW(E) = {$, =})
